request.prompt: A single round bas-relief medallion of a roaring lion head, carved in low relief on a flat circular plaque with a flat back, like a coin seal or heraldic crest. Front-facing lion head, jaws wide open in a roar showing the fangs, heavy brow, broad nose, and a full thick mane of bold carved locks framing the whole face in a ring. Bold simple sculpted shapes, crisp deep recesses, no fine texture. Plain matte stone, one material, no colour, no paint. Centred, one object, no text, no background, no other objects.
